description: The Enterprise crew faces a renewed Gorn threat while personal relationships and Starfleet ideals are tested by war memories, temporal interference and increasingly strange first-contact situations.

s02e01.description: Spock takes the Enterprise on an unauthorized mission after La'an sends a distress call from a disputed mining world.

s02e02.description: Una stands trial over her Illyrian genetic modifications, forcing Starfleet to confront the gap between its ideals and its laws.

s02e03.description: La'an is pulled into an alternate timeline with James Kirk and must travel to twenty-first-century Earth to repair history.

s02e04.description: Pike returns to a world from his past where a strange radiation field erases memories and threatens to trap the landing party permanently.

s02e05.description: An accident temporarily makes Spock fully human just as he must survive a crucial ceremonial dinner with T'Pring's family.

s02e06.description: Uhura begins hearing a mysterious signal that no one else can perceive while the Enterprise assists construction of a new fuel facility.

s02e07.description: Two Starfleet officers from the distant future are accidentally transported aboard Pike's Enterprise and struggle not to damage history.

s02e08.description: A former Klingon general visits the Enterprise, forcing M'Benga and Chapel to confront what they did and endured during the Klingon War.

s02e09.description: A subspace anomaly causes the crew to involuntarily express their private feelings through song, turning personal secrets into a shipwide crisis.

s02e10.description: A colony near Gorn space is attacked, leaving Pike's crew to mount a rescue while the Enterprise faces an enemy fleet.
